full_judgment: 5. House No. 27 Banga Bandhu Avenue, Dhaka originally belonged to Sufia Musa Salejhee on the basis of decree passed in TS No.153 of 1960 in her favour on 21-6-60 and she sold the said property to respondent No. 3 Kamruddin on 15-3-63 and since then said Kamruddin was in possession of the property partly through monthly tenants partly in Khas. While in such title and possession he entered into an agreement on 28-12-70 with Abdullah Bhuiyan to sell the house to him at a consideration of Taka 1,52,000.00 and on receipt of the sum of Taka 1,20,000.00 as advance delivered part possession of the house to the said buyer and promised to deliver possession of the rest on or before registration of the kabala. The said Abdullah Bhuiyan having died during the war of liberation his father Abul Hossain Bhuiyan and mother Safurun Nessa inherited her interest. After liberation Abul Hossain Bhuiyan father of Abdullah Bhuiyan asked the respondent No. 3 to execute and register kabala in terms of the aforesaid agreement but he having refused to do so said Abul Hossain Bhuiyan and Safurun Nessa filed TS No. 211 of 1977 in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge Dhaka for specific performance of contract and the suit was decreed ex parte on 3-3-78 and they got kabala executed and registered through Court in 1979. While the said Abul Hossain Bhuiyan was in part possession of the property through his employees carrying on restaurant business his employees inducted some women and others in different portions of the building as monthly tenants towards the end of 1979. These tenants formed an association named Jatiya Mohila Samity and trying to get an allotment of the building in their favour treating the house as an abandoned property. Abul Hossain Bhuiyan died an 16-1-85 and as such, he could not take steps against the trespassers and unauthorised persons before his death. Thereafter the said women managed to get an order of allotment in their favour treating the property as abandoned property. The tenanted portion was in possession of Mr. Abdul Majid Khan who died leaving sons and they started Misc. Case No. 42 of 1982. Thereafter Govt. started Misc. Case No. 50 of 1982 but the same was dismissed and subsequently revieved and other case was pending and that order of restoration was challenged in CR Case No. 72 of 1986. Heirs of Abul Hossain Bhuiyan were substituted in the Title Execution Case No. 39 of 1978 and Misc. Case No. 50 of 1982 and those cases are still pending and, as such the building cannot be treated as abandoned property and inclusion of the same in the 'Ka' list was illegal.
